lenses.title: Infrastructure & DevOps
lenses.summary: George builds and operates hybrid infrastructure with an emphasis on reliability, automation, and pragmatic tooling. He runs GitLab CI/CD across dozens of projects, manages Linux servers, container orchestration, and CDN migrations, and ties everything into observability dashboards that feed real-time alerts.
key_points: Operates 36 GitLab projects with 739 CI pipelines and self-hosted runners, maintaining high build success rates.
Manages hybrid infrastructure spanning VMware ESXi, Cloudflare CDN, and dual MySQL replicas with tested backups.
Monitors 31 services via Uptime Kuma with alert channels wired into Mattermost for 24x7 observability.

lenses.title: Manufacturing operations
lenses.summary: George has spent decades keeping production lines, firmware stations, and ecommerce fulfillment steady. He pairs automation savvy with people leadership so plants, logistics centers, and shop-floor systems stay online and profitable.
key_points: Raised database performance by 93 percent and sustained 99 percent uptime for manufacturing and sales systems.
Ran Sony's TiVo firmware upgrade station and hardware diagnostics labs, ensuring national-scale reliability.
Led maintenance teams for robotics, conveyors, and PLC-driven packaging equipment with hands-on repair and programming.
source_notes: Software Engineer and Team Manager, Sony Electronics
Maintenance and Automation Technician, T. Marzetti Company

lenses.title: Technology leadership
lenses.summary: George scales teams, translates executive goals into roadmaps, and keeps builders close to outcomes. His career runs from hands-on coding to directing cross-functional groups while staying technical.
key_points: Guides blended in-house and offshore teams with Agile delivery, analytics, and transparent roadmaps.
Improves performance, security posture, and observability while mentoring engineers and operators.
Bridges executive goals and shop-floor constraints, keeping communication steady across departments.
source_notes: Senior Software Engineer and Manager, Universal SmartComp

lenses.title: Security posture
lenses.summary: George treats security as an operational discipline, not a checkbox. He runs continuous vulnerability scanning across all public assets, enforces zero-trust access, and builds layered defenses from network hardening to email authentication, closing findings systematically.
key_points: Scans 36 public assets continuously via HostedScan and OWASP ZAP with zero critical/high issues in backlog.
Hardened infrastructure with Authentik SSO, HashiCorp Vault, CrowdSec, and DMARC at p=reject covering 1.5M emails/month.
Captured industrial protocol PCAPs and tuned security tools to protect manufacturing systems while migrating to zero-trust.
